urunler.name: Vekil Pro Premium
urunler._groupLevel: 2 = alt kademe. AI (level 1) üst kademe; böylece Temel'den AI'a geçiş Apple tarafında YÜKSELTME sayılıyor (IAP_KURULUM.md §2).
urunler.incelemeNotu: Vekil Pro Premium unlocks unlimited case files, clients and documents, plus the finance module (fees, collections, expenses). Free accounts already include unlimited case-law search, legal calculators and petition templates; this subscription removes the record limits and opens finance. Purchase screen: Settings > Vekil Premium (opens the "Vekil Pro Üyelik" plans screen), or the lock icon on any limited screen. Testable with a StoreKit sandbox account.

urunler.name: Vekil Pro AI
urunler.incelemeNotu: Vekil Pro AI unlocks the AI assistant: legal research over Turkish court decisions, petition drafting and document review. It also includes everything in Vekil Pro Premium. Every statute reference and case citation the assistant returns is checked against our corpus and labelled verified / not found / impossible. Purchase screen: Settings > Vekil Premium (opens the "Vekil Pro Üyelik" plans screen). Testable with a StoreKit sandbox account.
